notes: This is the SECOND sample on this route (round 25's X41 seat took the first). It was taken independently, with a different instrument shape (concurrency sweep + sustained leg + labelled control), while the round-26 wave was live.

Unlike round 5 (native model-registry rejection) and round 10 (402 insufficient funds), this round produced live concurrent worker artifacts and thousands of served completions, so the route resolved, dispatched and returned work.

Wall time here is a short-completion round-trip (max_tokens 64, non-streaming, through the local shim), NOT the TTFT/TPS figure a battery would produce; it is a liveness and load measurement, not a latency score.
